question: How are NYC crashes distributed across the days of the week, 2013 to 2025?

initial_plan.answerability: yes — the file has one row per police-reported crash and a crash_date from which day of week can be derived
initial_plan.metric: Number of crash records by day of week
initial_plan.denominator: No denominator; count of crash records
initial_plan.population: Police-reported crash records with a valid crash_date in calendar years 2013 through 2025 inclusive
initial_plan.grouping: Day of week derived from crash_date, Monday through Sunday
